ModMetaData.name: RimMind - Extension - ModelService
ModMetaData.author: mcocdaa
ModMetaData.description: Extended Model Service Provider and Local Gateway adapter for RimMind. Adds support for multi-provider routing (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Claude Messages, Local Subscription Gateways / sub2api / newapi / Codex Proxy) with auto-failover, load balancing, and connectivity diagnostics. [v1.0]
